# Community Rule Column 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** Anyone who knowingly lies about community property shall be barred from sharing the sacred meal for one year and shall have

**2** his food reduced by one quarter. Anyone who speaks to a fellow member with stubbornness or impatient

**3** anger, thereby undermining the standing of a member ranked above him — he has brought judgment on himself; he shall be penalized

**4** for one year. Anyone who utters an oath using the sacred Name — whether he blasphemes while under

**5** affliction or for any reason at all, whether during Scripture reading or during prayer — shall be permanently expelled and shall never return

**6** to the community council. If someone speaks against one of the priests whose names are enrolled

**7** in the register while in a state of anger, he shall be penalized for one year and separated from sharing the sacred meal with

**8** the assembly. But if it was unintentional, his penalty is six months. Anyone who deliberately

**9** tells a lie shall be penalized for six months. Anyone who unjustly insults a fellow

**10** member shall be penalized for a full year and excluded. Anyone who deceives a fellow member

**11** or knowingly does him harm — his penalty is six months. If the harm was through mere carelessness

**12** toward a fellow member — his penalty is three months. Anyone who takes a fellow member's

**13** belongings without asking — his penalty is three months. Anyone who harbors a grudge

**14** against a fellow member without just cause shall be penalized for six months. Likewise, anyone who

**15** takes revenge on his own behalf in any matter — his penalty is six months. Anyone who speaks idle nonsense — three months. Anyone who interrupts another

**16** while he is still speaking — ten days. Anyone who falls asleep during the full assembly

**17** meeting — thirty days. Likewise, anyone who walks out of the assembly meeting without

**18** permission or good reason, up to three times in a single meeting, shall be penalized for ten days. But if

**19** he walks out while the assembly is standing for prayer — thirty days. Anyone who appears undressed before a fellow

**20** member when it is not necessary — six months. Anyone who spits during the assembly

**21** meeting — thirty days. Anyone who gestures with his left hand

**22** instead of his right — ten days. Anyone who speaks maliciously about a fellow member

**23** shall be barred from the sacred meal for one year and penalized. But anyone who speaks maliciously about

**24** the community as a whole shall be permanently expelled with no right of return. Anyone who grumbles against

**25** the community's leadership shall be permanently expelled with no right of return.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 7 is the community's disciplinary code. "The Many" is rendered as "the assembly" or "the community" for clarity. "Pure food" becomes "sacred meal" to convey both the ritual and communal dimensions. Penalties escalate from ten-day suspensions to permanent banishment, reflecting a tightly regulated communal life.*
